function.name: is_d3dkmt_global
function.description: This function checks if a given handle is a global D3DKMT handle.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: The handle to be checked.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the handle is a global D3DKMT handle, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: index_to_handle
function.description: This function shifts the bits of the index to the left by 6 places and performs a bitwise OR operation with D3DKMT_HANDLE_BIT, then returns the result.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: This parameter represents the index that will be shifted and used in the bitwise OR operation.

function.return_type: D3DKMT_HANDLE, which represents the result of the bitwise operations performed on the index.

function.name: handle_to_index
function.description: This function takes a handle, performs a bitwise AND operation with a hexadecimal number, and then right shifts the result by 6 bits.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle that the function operates on.

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the bitwise operations on the input handle.

function.name: init_handle_table
function.description: This function initializes a handle table by allocating memory for it and setting up its end and next pointers. If memory allocation fails, it returns a status indicating no memory. Otherwise, it returns a status of success.
function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns STATUS_NO_MEMORY if memory allocation fails, and STATUS_SUCCESS if the function executes successfully.

function.name: alloc_object_handle
function.description: This function allocates a handle for a d3dkmt_object. It locks the d3dkmt_lock mutex, initializes the handle table if it's not already initialized, finds an empty slot in the handle table, assigns the handle to the object, and then unlocks the mutex. If it can't find an empty slot, it tries to grow the handle table. If it still can't find an empty slot, it returns an error status.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: This is the object for which the function is trying to allocate a handle.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if a handle was successfully allocated for the object, or STATUS_NO_MEMORY if it couldn't allocate a handle.

function.name: free_object_handle
function.description: This function frees an object handle by setting the corresponding index in the objects array to NULL and resetting the local field of the object to 0. It uses a mutex lock to ensure thread safety.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: This is the object handle that is to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: get_d3dkmt_object
function.description: This function retrieves a d3dkmt_object from an array of objects using a given handle and type. It locks the operation with a mutex to ensure thread safety. If the object does not exist, or the local handle or type does not match, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: A handle used to locate the d3dkmt_object

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the d3dkmt_object to be retrieved

function.return_type: void pointer, represents the retrieved d3dkmt_object or NULL if the object does not exist or does not match the given handle or type

function.name: d3dkmt_object_alloc
function.description: This function allocates memory for a d3dkmt_object, sets its type, and returns a pointer to it.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the memory to be allocated for the object

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the d3dkmt_object

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer. This will point to the allocated d3dkmt_object.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the function execution. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the function executes successfully, and STATUS_NO_MEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: d3dkmt_object_create
function.description: This function creates a new d3dkmt object and assigns values to its properties. It also handles server requests and responses related to the object creation.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Pointer to the d3dkmt object to be created

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Unsigned integer value to be assigned to the object

parameters.name: shared
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether the object is shared or not

parameters.name: runtime
parameters.description: Pointer to the runtime data

parameters.name: runtime_size
parameters.description: Size of the runtime data

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the function execution. If the function executes successfully, it returns a status code. If not, it returns an error code.

function.name: d3dkmt_object_update
function.description: This function updates a d3dkmt_object with the given runtime data and size. It communicates with a server to perform the update and returns a status code indicating the success or failure of the operation.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The d3dkmt_object to be updated

parameters.name: runtime
parameters.description: The runtime data to update the object with

parameters.name: runtime_size
parameters.description: The size of the runtime data

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. A non-zero value indicates an error.

function.name: d3dkmt_object_open
function.description: This function opens a D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Driver) object and sets its properties. It also handles server requests and allocates object handles.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Pointer to the D3DKMT object to be opened

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: Global handle for the D3DKMT object

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle for the D3DKMT object

parameters.name: runtime
parameters.description: Pointer to the runtime environment of the D3DKMT object

parameters.name: runtime_size
parameters.description: Pointer to the size of the runtime environment of the D3DKMT object

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the function execution. If the status is zero, the function was successful, otherwise an error occurred

function.name: d3dkmt_object_query
function.description: This function queries a global object and retrieves its runtime size.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the object to query.

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: A handle to the global object to query.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: A handle used for the server object.

parameters.name: runtime_size
parameters.description: A pointer to store the runtime size of the object.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. If the status is non-zero, the operation failed.

function.name: d3dkmt_object_free
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated to the d3dkmt_object. It first checks if the object's local and handle properties are not null, and if so, it calls the respective functions to free them. Finally, it frees the object itself.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the d3dkmt_object that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: alloc_object_attributes
function.description: This function allocates memory for object attributes, checks the validity of the attributes, and copies them into the allocated memory. It also calculates the length of the allocated memory.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Pointer to the object attributes to be allocated and copied

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer where the allocated memory address will be stored

parameters.name: ret_len
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable where the length of the allocated memory will be stored

function.return_type: unsigned int, represents the status of the function execution. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the function executes successfully, and error status codes otherwise

function.name: d3dkmt_init_vulkan
function.description: This function initializes the Vulkan driver and creates a Vulkan instance. It also loads several Vulkan functions.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: d3dkmt_use_vulkan
function.description: This function checks if the Vulkan instance is initialized and returns its status.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not accept any parameters.

function.return_type: BOOL, a boolean value indicating whether the Vulkan instance is initialized or not.

function.name: validate_open_object_attributes
function.description: This function validates the attributes of an open object. It checks if the object attributes are valid, if the object name is aligned and valid, and if the root directory is present when the object name is not.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Pointer to the object attributes to be validated

function.return_type: unsigned int, represents the status of the validation. It can be STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER, STATUS_DATATYPE_MISALIGNMENT, STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_INVALID, or STATUS_SUCCESS

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenAdapterFromHdc
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It is meant to open an adapter from a handle to device context but currently just returns a status indicating no memory.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that describes the adapter to open

function.return_type: NTSTATUS representing the status of the operation. Currently, it always returns STATUS_NO_MEMORY indicating failure due to lack of memory

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIEscape
function.description: This function handles the escape sequences in the D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Driver) context. It updates the resource if the escape type is D3DKMT_ESCAPE_UPDATE_RESOURCE_WINE, otherwise it returns an error.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the D3DKMT_ESCAPE structure that contains the escape sequences to be handled.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the resource is not found, STATUS_NO_MEMORY for unhandled escape sequences, and the status of the resource update operation for D3DKMT_ESCAPE_UPDATE_RESOURCE_WINE escape type.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICloseAdapter
function.description: This function closes a graphics adapter by freeing the associated d3dkmt_object. It returns an NTSTATUS indicating the success or failure of the operation.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_CLOSEADAPTER structure that describes the adapter to close.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, or STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is invalid.

function.name: get_vulkan_physical_devices
function.description: This function retrieves the physical devices available in the Vulkan instance and returns the count of these devices.

parameters.name: devices
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a VkPhysicalDevice structure. This parameter is used to store the list of physical devices retrieved.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the count of physical devices retrieved. If the function fails to retrieve the devices, it returns 0.

function.name: get_vulkan_physical_device
function.description: This function retrieves a Vulkan physical device associated with a given LUID. It first gets the UUID from the LUID, then iterates over all available Vulkan physical devices until it finds one with a matching UUID.

parameters.name: luid
parameters.description: A pointer to a LUID (Locally Unique Identifier) that is used to identify the Vulkan physical device.

function.return_type: VkPhysicalDevice, which represents the Vulkan physical device associated with the provided LUID. If no such device is found, the function returns VK_NULL_HANDLE.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenAdapterFromLuid
function.description: This function opens an adapter using a locally unique identifier (LUID). It checks if Vulkan is available and if the Vulkan physical device can be found. If successful, it assigns the LUID to the adapter and sets the adapter handle.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_OPENADAPTERFROMLUID structure that describes the adapter to open.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, representing the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns the error status.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICreateDevice
function.description: This function creates a device in the Direct3D Kernel Mode Thunk (D3DKMT). It allocates memory for the device, assigns it a locally unique identifier (LUID) from the adapter, and assigns the device's local handle to the 'hDevice' member of the 'desc' parameter. If any step fails, it frees the allocated memory and returns the error status.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_CREATEDEVICE structure that describes the device to be created.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the device creation operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, otherwise returns an error status code.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIDestroyDevice
function.description: This function destroys a device in the D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Driver) context. It checks if the device handle is valid, sets the VidPn source owner for the device, and then frees the device object.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_DESTROYDEVICE structure that describes the device to be destroyed.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, or STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is invalid or the device handle is not found.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIQueryAdapterInfo
function.description: This function queries the adapter information based on the type specified in the desc parameter. It handles two types: KMTQAITYPE_CHECKDRIVERUPDATESTATUS and KMTQAITYPE_DRIVERVERSION. For other types, it returns STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_QUERYADAPTERINFO structure that describes the type of adapter information to query and where to store the queried information.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. It can return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is invalid, STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, or STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED if the type specified in desc is not handled.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIQueryStatistics
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It is intended to query statistics but currently only returns a success status.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.description: Pointer to a D3DKMT_QUERYSTATISTICS structure that will receive the statistics data.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. Currently, it always returns STATUS_SUCCESS.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIQueryVideoMemoryInfo
function.description: This function queries the video memory information of a physical device.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_QUERYVIDEOMEMORYINFO structure that describes the video memory.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the parameters are not valid, or STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED if the process does not have the necessary access rights.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDISetQueuedLimit
function.description: This function is a stub and not yet implemented. It is expected to set a limit to a queue.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_SETQUEUEDLIMIT structure that describes the queue limit to set.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. In this case, it always returns STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED indicating that the function is not yet implemented.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDISetVidPnSourceOwner
function.description: This function sets the owner of a video present network (VidPN) source. It checks the parameters, removes the current owner if necessary, and adds a new owner. It locks and unlocks the d3dkmt_lock mutex to ensure thread safety.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_SETVIDPNSOURCEOWNER structure that describes the VidPN source owner to set.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It can return STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the parameters are not valid, STATUS_GRAPHICS_VIDPN_SOURCE_IN_USE if the VidPN source is already in use, or STATUS_NO_MEMORY if there is not enough memory to complete the operation.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICheckOcclusion
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It is intended to check occlusion but currently returns an error status.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Pointer to a D3DKMT_CHECKOCCLUSION structure that describes the occlusion to check.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. Currently, it always returns STATUS_PROCEDURE_NOT_FOUND indicating that the procedure does not exist.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICheckVidPnExclusiveOwnership
function.description: This function checks if the video present network (VidPn) source has exclusive ownership. It locks the d3dkmt_lock mutex before checking and unlocks it after the check. If the VidPn source has exclusive ownership, it returns STATUS_GRAPHICS_PRESENT_OCCLUDED; otherwise, it returns STATUS_SUCCESS.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_CHECKVIDPNEXCLUSIVEOWNERSHIP structure that describes the VidPn source to check for exclusive ownership.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is invalid, STATUS_GRAPHICS_PRESENT_OCCLUDED if the VidPn source has exclusive ownership, and STATUS_SUCCESS otherwise.

function.name: compare_vulkan_physical_devices
function.description: This function compares two Vulkan physical devices based on their type rank and device UUID. It uses a predefined ranking system for device types and memcmp for comparing device UUIDs.

parameters.name: v1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first Vulkan physical device to be compared

parameters.name: v2
parameters.description: Pointer to the second Vulkan physical device to be compared

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the comparison. If the return value is less than, equal to, or greater than zero, it indicates that the first device is considered to be respectively less than, equal to, or greater than the second.

function.name: get_vulkan_gpus
function.description: This function retrieves information about the physical devices (GPUs) that support Vulkan, stores them in a list, and returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation was successful or not.

parameters.name: gpus
parameters.description: A pointer to a list where the information about the Vulkan GPUs will be stored.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation was successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: free_vulkan_gpu
function.description: This function frees up the memory allocated to the vulkan_gpu structure and its name.

parameters.name: gpu
parameters.description: A pointer to the vulkan_gpu structure that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIShareObjects
function.description: This function shares objects between processes in the context of Direct3D Kernel Mode Threading. It can handle different types of objects such as resources, mutexes, and syncs.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of objects to be shared

parameters.name: handles
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of handles of the objects to be shared

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Pointer to the attributes of the objects to be shared

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: The access rights for the shared objects

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Pointer to the handle that will receive the handle of the shared objects

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the object count or types are unsupported, or if the sharing operation fails for any other reason

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICreateAllocation2
function.description: This function is used to create a new allocation in the device context. It validates the parameters, checks for existing resources, creates new resources if necessary, and handles errors.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a structure that contains the parameters for the allocation creation.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful. Otherwise, it returns an error code such as STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER, STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE, etc.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICreateAllocation
function.description: This function creates an allocation by calling the function NtGdiDdDDICreateAllocation2 with the same parameters.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Pointer to a D3DKMT_CREATEALLOCATION structure that describes the allocation to be created.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIDestroyAllocation2
function.description: This function destroys a specified allocation. It checks the validity of the parameters and the allocation objects. If any of the checks fail, it returns an error status. If all checks pass, it frees the allocation objects and returns a success status.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_DESTROYALLOCATION2 structure that describes the allocation to destroy.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error status.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIDestroyAllocation
function.description: This function destroys a previously created allocation.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Pointer to a D3DKMT_DESTROYALLOCATION structure that describes the allocation to destroy.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. Returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the params pointer is NULL.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenResource
function.description: This function opens a resource in the Direct3D Kernel Mode Thunk (D3DKMT). It validates the parameters, allocates memory for the resource and allocation objects, opens the object, allocates an object handle, and updates the parameters with the resource and allocation details.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_OPENRESOURCE structure that describes the resource to open.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the completion status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, and an error status code if it fails.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenResource2
function.description: This function opens a resource in the D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Thunk) layer. It allocates and initializes resource and allocation objects, checks for valid parameters, and handles potential failures.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_OPENRESOURCE structure that contains the parameters for opening the resource.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error status code.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenResourceFromNtHandle
function.description: This function opens a resource from a handle provided by the NT kernel. It performs several checks on the parameters and if any of them fails, it returns an error status. If all checks pass, it allocates and opens objects for resource, mutex and sync. If any of these operations fail, it frees the allocated objects and returns the error status. If all operations are successful, it updates the parameters with the local handles of the allocated objects and returns a success status.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure that contains the parameters required for opening a resource from a NT handle. The structure includes fields for private runtime data, total private driver data buffer, open allocation info, number of allocations, NT handle, keyed mutex private runtime data, private runtime data size, keyed mutex private runtime data size, resource handle, keyed mutex handle, sync object handle, total private driver data buffer size, and resource private driver data size.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful. If any of the checks on the parameters fail, it returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER. If any of the object allocation or opening operations fail, it returns the error status returned by these operations.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenNtHandleFromName
function.description: This function opens a handle to a named object in the NT namespace. It validates the object attributes, starts a server request to open the object with the specified name, and returns the status of the operation.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a structure that contains the name of the object to open, the desired access, and the object attributes.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns STATUS_SUCCESS. If the function fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIQueryResourceInfo
function.description: This function queries resource information for a given device and updates the parameters with the queried data.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_QUERYRESOURCEINFO structure that, on input, specifies the device and resource. On output, the structure contains the queried resource information.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, otherwise returns an error code such as STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIQueryResourceInfoFromNtHandle
function.description: This function queries resource information from an NT handle.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a structure that contains the NT handle and other related information.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns STATUS_SUCCESS.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICreateKeyedMutex2
function.description: This function creates a keyed mutex object and returns the status of the operation. It also updates the parameters structure with the handle of the mutex object.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_CREATEKEYEDMUTEX2 structure that, on input, contains the initial value and security attributes for the keyed mutex. On output, the structure contains the handle of the keyed mutex.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is invalid, or other NTSTATUS codes depending on the error occurred during the operation.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICreateKeyedMutex
function.description: This function creates a keyed mutex by calling the NtGdiDdDDICreateKeyedMutex2 function. It initializes the parameters for the NtGdiDdDDICreateKeyedMutex2 function, checks if the input parameters are valid, and assigns the returned handle and mutex to the input parameters.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_CREATEKEYEDMUTEX structure that, on input, contains the initial value for the keyed mutex. On output, it receives the handle and the keyed mutex.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is STATUS_SUCCESS. If the input parameter is null, it returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER.

function.name: d3dkmt_destroy_mutex
function.description: This function destroys a mutex object, releases the mutex if it is owned, and frees the associated object.

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: This is a handle to the mutex object that needs to be destroyed.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, and STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the mutex object is not found.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIDestroyKeyedMutex
function.description: This function is used to destroy a keyed mutex.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_DESTROYKEYEDMUTEX structure that contains the keyed mutex to be destroyed.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the completion status of the operation.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenKeyedMutex2
function.description: This function opens a keyed mutex object and returns a handle to it. It also checks the validity of the parameters and handles any errors that might occur during the process.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_OPENKEYEDMUTEX2 structure that contains the necessary data to open the mutex.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the completion status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, and an error status code if it fails.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenKeyedMutex
function.description: This function opens a keyed mutex object. It first checks if the parameter is valid, then opens the mutex using the NtGdiDdDDIOpenKeyedMutex2 function, and assigns the handle of the opened mutex back to the parameter.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_OPENKEYEDMUTEX structure that, on input, contains the handle to the shared resource. On output, it receives the handle to the keyed mutex object.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. Returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is invalid.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenKeyedMutexFromNtHandle
function.description: This function opens a keyed mutex object from an NT handle.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_OPENKEYEDMUTEXFROMNTHANDLE structure that describes the keyed mutex to open.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIAcquireKeyedMutex2
function.description: This function acquires a keyed mutex object. It waits for the mutex object to be released before returning, and it adjusts the mutex's state based on the parameters passed.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_ACQUIREKEYEDMUTEX2 structure that describes the keyed mutex to acquire.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the parameters are not valid, or STATUS_PENDING if the operation is still pending.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIAcquireKeyedMutex
function.description: This function acquires a keyed mutex. It initializes a D3DKMT_ACQUIREKEYEDMUTEX2 structure, copies the values from the input parameters, calls NtGdiDdDDIAcquireKeyedMutex2 with the new structure, and then updates the FenceValue in the original structure with the new value.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_ACQUIREKEYEDMUTEX structure that contains the parameters for the function.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. Returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the params pointer is NULL.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIReleaseKeyedMutex2
function.description: This function releases a keyed mutex object. It first checks if the mutex object is valid, then sends a server request to release the mutex. If the server call is successful, it sets the mutex ownership to FALSE.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Pointer to a D3DKMT_RELEASEKEYEDMUTEX2 structure that describes the keyed mutex to release.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is STATUS_SUCCESS. If the function fails, the return value can be STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the mutex object is not valid.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIReleaseKeyedMutex
function.description: This function releases a keyed mutex. It initializes a D3DKMT_RELEASEKEYEDMUTEX2 structure with the values from the input parameter, then calls the NtGdiDdDDIReleaseKeyedMutex2 function with this structure.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Pointer to a D3DKMT_RELEASEKEYEDMUTEX structure that contains the keyed mutex to be released.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is null.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICreateSynchronizationObject2
function.description: This function creates a synchronization object for a device and returns the status of the operation.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure that contains information about the synchronization object to be created.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error status code.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICreateSynchronizationObject
function.description: This function creates a synchronization object for a device. It checks the type of the synchronization object and if it is not a mutex or semaphore, it returns an invalid parameter status. If the type is valid, it creates the synchronization object and assigns it to the handle in the input parameters.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_CREATESYNCHRONIZATIONOBJECT structure that describes the synchronization object to be created.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the function execution. If the function succeeds, the return value is STATUS_SUCCESS. If the function fails, the return value can be STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenSyncObjectFromNtHandle2
function.description: This function opens a synchronization object from an NT handle and allocates and opens a d3dkmt object.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure that contains the parameters for opening a synchronization object from an NT handle.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the parameters are invalid, or other status codes depending on the failure.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenSyncObjectFromNtHandle
function.description: This function opens a synchronization object from an NT handle.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure that contains the NT handle and will receive the handle of the opened synchronization object.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is null, or other status codes depending on the failure.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenSyncObjectNtHandleFromName
function.description: This function opens a synchronization object handle from a given name, validates the object attributes, and sets the handle in the provided parameters structure.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure that contains the object attributes and desired access. The function sets the handle in this structure.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is STATUS_SUCCESS. If the function fails, the return value is an error code.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIOpenSynchronizationObject
function.description: This function opens a synchronization object in the D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Threading) context. It checks if the shared handle is valid, allocates and opens a D3DKMT object, and assigns the local handle of the object to the synchronization object handle in the input parameters.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_OPENSYNCHRONIZATIONOBJECT structure that, on input, contains the shared handle of the synchronization object to open. On output, this structure contains the local handle of the opened synchronization object.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the function successfully opens the synchronization object. If the input parameters are null or the shared handle is invalid, it returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER. If there is an error in allocating or opening the D3DKMT object, it returns the error status.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIDestroySynchronizationObject
function.description: This function destroys a synchronization object in the D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Threading).

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a D3DKMT_DESTROYSYNCHRONIZATIONOBJECT structure that describes the synchronization object to destroy.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the completion status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is STATUS_SUCCESS. If the function fails, the return value is an error code.

function.name: get_resource_global_keyed_mutex
function.description: This function checks the size and version of the 'desc' parameter. If the size and version are supported, and if 'desc' has a keyed mutex but is not shared, it assigns the mutex and sync handles from 'desc' to 'mutex_global' and 'sync_global' respectively.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that contains the description of the DirectX Graphics Infrastructure (DXGI).

parameters.name: mutex_global
parameters.description: Pointer to a handle that will receive the mutex handle from 'desc' if the conditions are met.

parameters.name: sync_global
parameters.description: Pointer to a handle that will receive the sync handle from 'desc' if the conditions are met.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return any value

function.name: d3dkmt_object_get_fd
function.description: This function retrieves a file descriptor for a given D3DKMT object.

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: This is a handle to the D3DKMT object for which the file descriptor is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: int, represents the file descriptor of the D3DKMT object. Returns -1 if the object is not found or if there is a failure in receiving the object.

function.name: d3dkmt_create_resource
function.description: This function is used to create a new resource in the D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Threading) environment. It allocates and initializes a new resource and allocation objects, creates the resource object, assigns the allocation object to the resource, and returns the local handle of the resource object. If any of these operations fail, it cleans up any allocated objects and returns 0.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor used for creating the resource object

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: Pointer to a global handle. If not null, the global handle of the resource object is stored here

function.return_type: D3DKMT_HANDLE, represents the local handle of the created resource object. If the function fails, it returns 0

function.name: d3dkmt_open_resource
function.description: This function opens a resource in the D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Threading) context. It allocates and initializes various objects, checks for errors, and handles them appropriately. It also manages memory for runtime data.

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: A handle to the global D3DKMT resource

parameters.name: shared
parameters.description: A handle to the shared resource

parameters.name: mutex_local
parameters.description: A pointer to a local mutex handle

parameters.name: sync_local
parameters.description: A pointer to a local synchronization handle

function.return_type: D3DKMT_HANDLE, represents a handle to the opened resource. If the function fails to open the resource, it returns 0

function.name: d3dkmt_destroy_resource
function.description: This function is used to destroy a resource in the D3DKMT (Direct3D Kernel Mode Threading). It first retrieves the resource and allocation objects associated with the provided handle, then frees the allocation and resource objects.

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: This is a handle to the resource that is to be destroyed.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, and STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the resource could not be retrieved.

function.name: d3dkmt_create_sync
function.description: This function creates a sync object and assigns it to a global handle if provided. If the creation fails, it cleans up the allocated memory and returns 0.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor used for object creation.

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: Pointer to a global handle where the created sync object will be assigned.

function.return_type: D3DKMT_HANDLE, represents the local handle of the created sync object. If the creation fails, it returns 0.

function.name: d3dkmt_open_sync
function.description: This function opens a synchronization object and returns its local handle. If the operation fails, it cleans up and returns 0.

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: A handle to the global object

parameters.name: shared
parameters.description: A handle to the shared object

function.return_type: D3DKMT_HANDLE, represents the local handle of the opened synchronization object, or 0 if the operation failed

function.name: d3dkmt_destroy_sync
function.description: This function destroys a sync object associated with a local handle. It first retrieves the sync object using the provided handle, then frees the memory occupied by the object.

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: This is a handle to the local sync object that needs to be destroyed.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, and STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the sync object could not be retrieved with the provided handle.
